text: Early on Thursdays the square by the station is full of vans.
Donnerstags ist der Platz am Bahnhof früh voller Wagen.

Two neighbourhood schemes keep household goods in use without anyone buying new ones. At a monthly repair workshop, volunteers guide visitors through fixing their own bicycles and appliances, and roughly two in three items work again afterwards. At the public library, a shelf of donated tools, grown from forty to more than two hundred, lends drills and ladders for a week at a time. Both depend on neighbours who turn up and look after shared things.
